# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 theme-ledger1 (design theme-econ 3.1, step 1): the crown's ledger of each theme (oe_te_).
# Generated by gen_theme_ui.py; edit the generator, not this file. Display only: read by the themes tab and the
# test page, never by an effect that changes the game.

# Theme scope (the card). Signed from the crown's side: what it pays is negative, what it receives positive.
# Army pay: the first maker's price (1 gold, no inflation) x the slider x army_size (navy_size for a naval
# theme); 0 for a theme his payment does not pay (civil course, chartered city).
oe_te_size = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { oe_theme_army_payment_trigger = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_pillars_naval_theme_trigger = yes } add = navy_size }
        else = { add = army_size }
    }
}
oe_te_slider_pct = { value = oe_theme_law_pay_ratio multiply = 100 }
oe_te_pay = { value = oe_te_size multiply = oe_theme_law_pay_ratio multiply = -1 }
# Officials sent from the capital (gen_theme_admin.py): oe_theme_official_cost each, as oe_theme_admin_monthly charges it.
oe_te_off = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_judge ?= 1 } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 } add = 1 }
    # perf audit 2026-11-20: the official cost walks the jurisdiction; read it once, and not at all without officials
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_theme_judge ?= 1 var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 } } multiply = oe_theme_official_cost }
    multiply = -1
}
# Remittance this month (gen_territory_status.py oe_ts_tribute): the amount, if the theme can pay it in full, else 0.
oe_te_trib = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_ts_tribute_amount > 0 gold >= oe_ts_tribute_amount } add = oe_ts_tribute_amount }
}
# The theme's own take of the tax base (its income; whether it comes out of the crown's taxes is not settled, case S/K
# of the design): the seat's location in full, each post's location at 30%. Only locations the crown owns.
oe_te_seat_tb = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes oe_te_seat_loc = yes } add = location_tax_base }
}
oe_te_post_tb = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes NOT = { oe_te_seat_loc = yes } } add = location_tax_base }
}
# perf audit 2026-11-20: one walk (the card line shows it on every theme); the same sum as
# oe_te_seat_tb x 1 + oe_te_post_tb x 0.3, rounded per location instead of per total.
oe_te_taxbase = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_te_seat_loc = yes } add = { value = location_tax_base multiply = 1 } }
        else = { add = { value = location_tax_base multiply = 0.3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (the page total): the same items summed over the themes the tab shows (Pillars members passing
# oe_theme_member_trigger, as the cards).
oe_te_sum_pay = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = oe_te_pay } } } }
oe_te_sum_off = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = oe_te_off } } } }
oe_te_sum_trib = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = oe_te_trib } } } }
oe_te_sum_net = { value = oe_te_sum_pay add = oe_te_sum_off add = oe_te_sum_trib }
oe_te_sum_gold = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = gold } } } }
oe_te_sum_tb = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = oe_te_taxbase } } } }
oe_te_sum_juris = { value = 0 if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { every_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } add = oe_theme_jurisdiction_size } } } }

oe_te_t_cinc = { value = monthly_income_total }
oe_te_t_cgold = { value = gold }
